children: Axis Bank Limited Sponsored GDR RegS (NSE:AXISBANK) reported Q2 profit rise led by NII, loan and deposit growth and resilient capital, while analysts expect further credit and margin recovery; bank launched EDPMS filings, saw rising agri lending and named Rahul Shukla Group Head amid a fraud-related mule-account freeze.
Previous Week Recap
Axis Bank Q2 NII Growth, Lower Provisions
: Axis Bank (AXISBANK) Q2: standalone net profit rose YoY, driven by NII growth and lower provisions; advances and deposits increased, NIM ~3.36%, GNPA ~1.16%, NNPA ~0.35%, capital adequacy ~16.27%.
FCNR(B) Deposits, International Loans
: AXISBANK: FCNR(B) deposits $10.62B; international loans $4.57B. FCNR(B) use led to an 8.6% sequential drop in non‑retail term deposits; adjusted figures show stronger deposit and advance growth.
Nuvama Keeps Buy, Credit Growth
: Nuvama keeps Buy on Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK), TP Rs1,650. Reports 22% YoY and 9% QoQ credit growth, margins ex‑FCNR ~3.47% flat; expects credit growth and margin recovery as liquidity deploys.
Q2FY27 Results Date, NIM Expectation
: AXISBANK will report Q2FY27 results Oct 17; earnings call 6:20 pm IST. Analysts expect strong loan and deposit growth and NIM near 3.1% for the quarter.
Rahul Shukla Appointed Group Head

: Axis Bank (AXISBANK) appointed Rahul Shukla, 57, as Group Head, Commercial & Bharat Banking effective Oct 19, 2026. Shukla has 30+ years in banking, including leadership roles at HDFC Bank and Citi.
JM Financial Names Axis Bank Favored Lender
: JM Financial names Axis Bank (AXISBANK) as a favored large lender, citing its strong liability franchise and execution, while noting expected near-term net interest margin pressure.
Farm-Loan Book Up, Agri Share Declines
: AXISBANK's farm-loan book rose 20% YoY in Q2FY27; agriculture loans fell to 8.9% of total lending from 9.3% a year earlier as overall lending grew faster.
GDR Added EDPMS Filing
: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK) added EDPMS filing on its digital platform on Oct 15, 2026, letting service exporters submit EDFs and report cross‑border service payments per RBI FEMA 2026 rules.
Fraud Victims Funds Frozen, AXISBANK Involvement
: Fraud victims across five states sent funds to an Axis Bank mule account in Hyderabad between Sept 21–29. Authorities froze remaining funds, helping avert Rs 1.53 crore linked to AXISBANK.
